rules.title: Berkeley Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords may not ask about or use criminal history in advertising, applications, tenant selection or decisions, and must give written notice and a chance to respond before acting on it. Fines of $1,000 to $10,000 per violation.
rules.key_value: ban on criminal-history inquiries and use in housing decisions
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental housing providers, current and prospective tenants in Berkeley
rules.exemptions: Lifetime sex offenders; limited public housing/Section 8 exemptions; owner-occupied 1-3 unit properties; owner move-back units; existing tenants subletting or adding roommates
rules.quoted_span: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.

notes: Page says council passed the ordinance April 14, 2020 but gives no effective date; effective_date left null.
